title.description: Title of the composition. May differ from the recording title. Freely mutable.

artistDid.description: DID of the artist publishing this record. Not necessarily the sole writer. Immutable.

iswc.description: International Standard Musical Work Code. Assigned by a PRO. Optional — see bazaarWid for self-issued alternative. Freely mutable.

bazaarWid.description: Self-issued Work Identifier. Generated as base32(SHA-256(artistDid + compositionTitle + writers[] + createdAt)). Writers array canonicalized before hashing. Shadows ISWC. id, sig, kid, and generatedAt are immutable. supersededByIswc is mutable — populated when a proper ISWC is obtained.

writers.description: Co-writers and their share splits. Optional — single-writer compositions may omit. Freely mutable.

ipi.description: Interested Parties Information number. Assigned by a PRO.

did.description: ATProto DID of this writer if they have one. Optional.

share.description: Percentage of the composition. All shares should sum to 100.

publishers.description: Publishing administrators for this composition. Freely mutable.

pro.description: PRO administering this publisher's share, e.g. ASCAP, BMI, SESAC, PRS.

proRegistrations.description: PRO registrations for this composition across territories. Freely mutable.

territory.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Omit for worldwide registration.

publishingLicenseTermsUri.description: AT-URI of the license.terms record governing publishing rights for this composition. Freely mutable.

songMetaUri.description: Optional AT-URI of a song record in an external namespace (e.g. ch.indiemusi.alpha.song). Freely mutable.

recordings.description: AT-URIs of catalog.item.digital records that are recordings of this composition. Informational only — the authoritative link direction is catalog.recording → catalog.composition via songMetaUri. Freely mutable.

copyrightRegistrationId.description: Copyright office registration ID if registered, e.g. US Copyright Office PA number. Freely mutable.
